properties.name: management.health.cocache.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the CoCache health indicator (DOWN only when the invalidation channel heartbeat fails).

properties.name: cocache.observation.enabled
properties.description: Whether to record a Micrometer Observation (cocache.load) around each source load and lease wait. Needs micrometer-observation and an ObservationRegistry bean.

properties.name: cocache.metrics.local-hits
properties.description: Whether to count L2 hits (CacheMetrics.localHits, meter cocache.hits{level=l2}). Off by default: counting adds one LongAdder increment to every L2 hit.

values.description: Redis backend built from Spring Data Redis connection details (default).
In-process InMemoryBackend for local development and tests: single process only, no cross-instance coherence.
